task_title: Ligand pose in a known pocket
claim: Predicted pose of BGC in glucose dehydrogenase (glucose-binding) is valid

verdict.claim: Predicted pose of BGC in glucose dehydrogenase (glucose-binding) is valid

findings.title: Alignment depth, distinct sequences, Neff and gap fraction
findings.message: no MSA declared for a co-folding model

findings.title: Required cofactors, ions and partners present
findings.message: components within 8.0 Å of BGC in 2VWH not supplied: NAP, ZN

thresholds.name: pocket_distance
thresholds.origin: Harness rule: a component of the reference entry within 8 Å of the declared ligand is required context; not yet calibrated

findings.title: Pocket residues resolved, no missing loops lining the pocket
findings.message: 19 pocket residues complete in 2VWH.cif

thresholds.name: pocket_distance
thresholds.origin: Harness rule: pocket residues have a heavy atom within 6 Å of the ligand; not yet calibrated

thresholds.name: missing_pocket_residues
thresholds.origin: Specification layer 2: stop when the pocket is incomplete

findings.title: Receptor state apo or holo
findings.message: 2VWH.cif holo: BGC, NAP in the site

findings.title: Receptor protonation at the stated pH
findings.message: receptor has no hydrogens (protonation not assigned); pKa within 1.0 of pH 7.4: GLU64A pKa 6.96, GLU150A pKa 8.39

thresholds.name: pka_margin
thresholds.origin: Harness rule: a titratable pocket residue with PROPKA pKa within 1 unit of the stated pH has an ambiguous state; not yet calibrated

findings.title: Ligand protonation and tautomers enumerated at the stated pH
findings.message: one state at pH 7.4 for every ligand

thresholds.name: ph_window
thresholds.origin: Harness rule: states enumerated by Dimorphite-DL within 1 pH unit of the stated pH; not yet calibrated

thresholds.name: states
thresholds.origin: Specification layer 2: warn when more than one plausible state

findings.title: Ligand conformers generated and minimised
findings.message: 10 ETKDG conformers per ligand, MMFF minimised

thresholds.name: conformers
thresholds.origin: Harness default number of ETKDG conformers; not yet calibrated

findings.title: Docking box encloses the pocket with margin
findings.message: no box declared; derived box encloses 11 contact residues and the BGC ligand with 2.0 Å margin

thresholds.name: margin
thresholds.origin: Harness rule: every pocket heavy atom lies at least 2 Å inside the box; not yet calibrated

thresholds.name: contact_distance
thresholds.origin: Harness rule: contact residues (heavy atom within 4 Å of the reference ligand) must have an atom inside the box; not yet calibrated

findings.title: Model training cutoff recorded
findings.message: boltz2 2023-06-01; diffdock 2019-01-01; reference 2VWH released 2009-01-13, before the cutoff of boltz2, diffdock

thresholds.name: training_cutoff
thresholds.origin: Specification, Layer 3 (applicability): stop when unknown

findings.title: Pocket similarity to pre-cutoff complexes (SuCOS times pocket coverage)
findings.message: max similarity 87.4 to 2VWH (BGC, SuCOS 0.922, coverage 0.947), released before 2019-01-01

thresholds.name: similarity
thresholds.origin: Specification layer 3: warn above a pocket similarity (SuCOS times pocket coverage) of 50

thresholds.name: entries
thresholds.origin: Harness budget: pre-cutoff holo entries compared per run

findings.title: Ligand analogues in pre-cutoff training systems
findings.message: 1079 PDB entries released before 2019-01-01 (diffdock cutoff) contain analogues of ligand above Tanimoto 0.9: 3MK, 4GL, 4N2, A1EKO, AFD, ALL

thresholds.name: tanimoto
thresholds.origin: Specification layer 3: analogues above 0.9 Tanimoto (RDKit topological fingerprint)

thresholds.name: systems
thresholds.origin: Specification layer 3: prevalent when analogues occur in more than 100 training systems

findings.title: Chain sequence identity to pre-cutoff entries (secondary measure)
findings.message: protein: 6 entries at 95 percent identity, 6 at 40 percent, released before 2019-01-01 (reported, not gating)

thresholds.name: identity
thresholds.origin: Specification layer 3: conventional 40 percent identity leakage threshold, reported as a secondary measure only

findings.title: Modality inside the validated set; token count against the training crop
findings.message: modalities protein, protein_ligand inside the validated set; 369 tokens

findings.title: Endpoint fits the tool
findings.message: endpoint pose produced by boltz2, diffdock

thresholds.name: endpoint
thresholds.origin: Specification, Layer 3 (applicability): no affinity from interface confidence, no protein-protein affinity from Boltz-2

findings.title: PoseBusters geometry, stereochemistry, clashes and protein contact
findings.message: 20 of 20 tests pass for boltz2/seed7/sample0; 3 of 3 poses pass all

thresholds.name: tests_failed
thresholds.origin: Specification, Layer 4 (output validity): stop on failure

findings.title: Torsional strain of the ligand pose
findings.message: 0 of 6 torsions above 2.5 kcal/mol in boltz2/seed7/sample0; strain 3.14 kcal/mol

thresholds.name: torsion_energy
thresholds.origin: Harness rule: a rotatable torsion whose MMFF energy lies more than 2.5 kcal/mol above the minimum of its rigid scan is unlikely; not yet calibrated

findings.title: Interaction fingerprint (PLIP)
findings.message: 28 interactions in boltz2/seed7/sample0 (hbond, hydrophobic, metal, pi_cation, salt_bridge); 24 distinct across 3 poses (reported)

findings.title: Buried ligand polar atoms without a hydrogen-bond partner
findings.message: 6 buried polar ligand atoms, all with a partner within 3.5 Å in boltz2/seed7/sample0

thresholds.name: relative_sasa
thresholds.origin: Harness rule: a ligand polar atom with relative SASA below 0.1 in the complex is buried; not yet calibrated

thresholds.name: hbond_distance
thresholds.origin: PLIP hydrogen bond distance cut-off (donor-acceptor 4.1 Å; harness uses 3.5 Å heavy-atom distance)

findings.title: Hydrophobic complementarity of buried ligand surface
findings.message: nonpolar fraction of protein contacts around 4 buried nonpolar ligand atoms in boltz2/seed7/sample0: 0.535

thresholds.name: fraction
thresholds.origin: Harness default anchored on 3PTB: the crystal benzamidine scores 0.51, Vina and Boltz-2 poses within 0.5 Å of it score 0.45 and 0.49; not calibrated on the benchmark

thresholds.name: relative_sasa
thresholds.origin: Harness rule: a ligand polar atom with relative SASA below 0.1 in the complex is buried; not yet calibrated

findings.title: Interactions of the crystal ligand reproduced by the pose
findings.message: boltz2/seed7/sample0 reproduces 5 of 6 BGC interactions: hbond ASN303A, hbond GLU150A, hbond HIS49A, hbond THR40A, salt_bridge HIS63A

thresholds.name: reproduced
thresholds.origin: Specification layer 4: warn when no key interaction is reproduced

findings.title: Pose stability under short restrained minimisation (OpenMM, AMBER14 and OpenFF)
findings.message: boltz2/seed7/sample0 moves 0.397 Å under restrained minimisation; 0 of 3 poses above 2.0 Å

thresholds.name: drift
thresholds.origin: Specification layer 4: warn when the pose moves beyond 2 Å under restrained minimisation

findings.title: Confidence restricted to the pocket; per-model thresholds
findings.message: boltz2/seed7/sample0: pocket_plddt 97.4

thresholds.name: boltz2.pocket_plddt
thresholds.origin: AlphaFold DB pLDDT bands (70 and above: confident backbone), applied to pocket residues; not calibrated for ligand pose

findings.title: Independent seeds counted separately from samples; duplicates flagged
findings.message: 3 independent seeds (3 poses); task default 5

thresholds.name: seeds_cofolding
thresholds.origin: Specification layer 5: default of five seeds per co-folding prediction

findings.title: Medoid of the largest cluster, populations, pairwise spread, site and pose accuracy
findings.message: medoid boltz2/seed7/sample0; 1 clusters, largest 3 of 3; pairwise RMSD median 0.10 Å (IQR 0.08 to 0.12); 3 of 3 poses within 4.0 Å of the site (BGC in 2VWH); 3 of 3 poses within 2.0 Å of the medoid

thresholds.name: cluster_rmsd
thresholds.origin: Specification layer 5: 2 Å symmetry-aware ligand RMSD (spyrmsd) separates pose clusters

thresholds.name: site_distance
thresholds.origin: Harness rule: a ligand centroid within 4 Å of the reference site centroid is placed in the site; not yet calibrated

thresholds.name: largest_fraction
thresholds.origin: Harness rule: the largest cluster holds at least half of the poses; not yet calibrated

findings.title: Agreement between methods, weighted by independence
findings.message: boltz2 vs diffdock 3.988 Å (high); boltz2 vs crystal 2VWH 0.291 Å (decisive); diffdock vs crystal 2VWH 4.079 Å (decisive)

thresholds.name: rmsd
thresholds.origin: Specification layer 5: pose agreement by symmetry-aware ligand RMSD at 2 Å

thresholds.origin: Specification layer 5: redocking must reproduce the crystal pose (2 Å ligand RMSD)
